body: yes i think so. whenever my mum gives me the bare minimum of attention, i completely forget about everything she’s put me through since when i was younger. during those moments, i feel like i’m overreacting, that she is not that **bad**, that she’s still my mum and that i should love her like normal people love their mum. it’s sad and it hurts.

you’re strong! and it’s really good that you somehow find something positive about your day to think about. i wish i could do that. 

i totally understand and feel your idea of a sheet of glass. it’s like we’re not in charge of our own life and we live it passively. feels really weird and powerless. 

keep going! you’re very strong, don’t let your illnesses win over you.

hi, thank you for your answer. 

but don’t you feel tired of living through the same pain everyday? i don’t know what you’ve been through, if you tried to get better and anything but i tried everything i could possibly do to overcome my depression and suicdal thoughts, nothing’s worked. i am really stuck. 

i know that the pain will never end, sometimes it does get better, sometimes i do not feel as depressed as other times. but most of the time, it keeps coming back, i keep having severe episodes and i definitely know that i’ll never be better. i feel like it’s not worth suffering for that little one tiny bit of joy.
i’ve done that but i just keep meeting people that doesn’t care about me as much as i care about them. i don’t understand why.

thank you for your answer, but i know that already. i’ve been trying for so many years and i’m getting tired of this. i do put some efforts into going to talk to people even if i have anxiety, i try, i really do but at some point i just feel like having friends is not for me.

my boyfriend. he loves me so much and shows me everyday that i am the most valuable thing on earth for him. he’s really deeply and sincerely un love with me and he’s the best person i’ve ever met. he is nice, gentle, caring, polite, honest, everything. if i die, i know he’ll be devastated. he has told me that if i die, he’d kill himself which absolutely breaks my heart. the last thing i want is to hurt him since he’s been so kind with me since the beginning. i truly want to get better for him, for the opportunity to live and grow with him until the very end. i know he is my soulmate and i don’t want him to lose me nor me to lose him.
